claims: A bell is a hollow percussion instrument.
A bell produces a ringing sound when struck by an internal clapper or external hammer.
Bells are used globally for signaling, music, or warnings in churches, schools, and ships.
Bells range from small handbells to large towers.
Common types of bells include cups, gongs, and jingle bells.
Bell Textron is an aerospace manufacturer known for helicopters and vertical lift aircraft.
Bell Helmets is a brand specializing in helmets for motorsports and cycling safety.
Bell Canada is a Canadian telecommunications company.
The word bell originates from English.
